quantitative_conclusions: L577-L500 best: AbsRel -0.0009795374 CI[-0.0029563832,0.0009279794],RMSE -0.0042806295 CI[-0.0110909127,0.0023037664],delta1 and band CIs also cross zero. F1 -0.0049397176 CI[-0.0080634628,-0.0016286769] worsens;seed directions negative/positive/negative. Earlier two-seed RMSE/band improvements do not retain an interval excluding zero after the third seed. Final comparison:all five CIs cross zero.

L577-R577 best and final:only boundary-band AbsRel has a CI excluding zero,improving at both endpoints in all seeds. Best difference -0.0063823728 CI[-0.01089418,-0.00181248];final -0.0066927543 CI[-0.010991,-0.00229753]. Other four metrics cross zero;prior two-seed overall improvement claims are superseded.

L577-B0:best and final improve AbsRel,RMSE,delta1 and boundary-band error with CIs excluding zero. F1 remains uncertain:best+0.0009344001 CI[-0.00771565,0.01034389],final+0.0050644525 CI[-0.00387932,0.01492565]. A lower overall error is not evidence that boundaries generally improve.

Final-best:AbsRel rises+0.0012852384 CI[0.0002506859,0.0022228197],all three seeds worse. delta1 falls -0.0043605222 CI[-0.0071388365,-0.0016261625]. F1 rises+0.0041300524 CI[0.0017639589,0.0070094163],but the third seed worsens. RMSE/band CIs cross zero. Preserve different endpoint tradeoffs;do not select final retrospectively on F1.

Bootstrap uses2000 image-weighted resamples of62 scenes,seed320119,with matched seeds averaged per image. CIs condition on these training seeds and are not multiplicity-corrected;seed sample SD is reported separately. Full three-seed results supersede provisional one/two-seed conclusions.

Final AbsRel0.0940388713 versus best0.0914634995 is2.8157% worse. It exceeds fixed1% threshold0.0923781345,as do1500/1800;no terminal500-step stable span. All three L577 stable_step values are null. Target0.10 reached by all three seeds,0.09 by two;missing targets are not zero.

Third-seed target0.10 starts100/confirms300 at174.197183s;0.09 never reached. Training loss falls0.05218 at1200 to0.04416 at2100 while validation stays near0.092-0.093 and ends0.09404. Late-loss-down/val-up indicator true,mild late degradation compatible with overfitting,not explosive collapse. Do not attribute it to early AMP skips without evidence.

interpretation: L577 improves overall and boundary-band accuracy over B0,but does not establish a general F1 gain. Adding77 fitting images to L500 yields an uncertain overall increment and lower best F1. Different seeds and best/final endpoints show distinct local tradeoffs. Continue the predeclared J/S queue without tuning.
